variables.physical_definition: Free-stream velocity: the characteristic mean flow velocity outside the boundary layer.
Kinematic viscosity of the fluid (momentum diffusivity).
Integrated mean kinetic energy: integral from wall to boundary-layer edge of the square of the local mean velocity with respect to wall-normal distance (∫ U(y)^2 dy).
Boundary-layer thickness (δ): distance from the wall to the location where the local mean velocity reaches 99% of free-stream.
Displacement thickness (δ*): the equivalent thickness that accounts for displacement of the outer flow due to the boundary layer.
Momentum thickness (θ): a measure of the boundary layer thickness weighted by the momentum deficit.
